<member name="M:Inno.Tooling.Documentation.DocumentationCommand.ExecuteAsync(System.String[],System.Threading.CancellationToken)">
    <summary>
    Explicitly indexes a selected checkout or queries an already prepared immutable snapshot.
    </summary>
    <param name="arguments">
    index, search, read, symbol, resource, status or catalog followed by engine-root, cache-root, docs-root,
    snapshot, source-tree, query, page, project, surface, section, id, offset, limit and format as applicable.
    Index requires docs-root. Read-only commands reject docs-root rather than implicitly refreshing mutable content.
    Reads optionally accept evidence-file and evidence-sha256 selected by an authenticated preparation boundary.
    </param>
    <param name="cancellationToken">
    Cancels preparation or reading while preserving the previous complete generation.
    </param>
    <returns>
    Zero for valid results including empty searches; two for missing, ambiguous or mismatched targets.
    Partial results have explicit continuations and do not assert contract completeness.
    </returns>
    <exception cref="T:System.ArgumentException">
    Options are absent, duplicated or invalid for the operation.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.IOException">
    The selected source or snapshot cannot be safely read or published.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.OperationCanceledException">
    The caller cancels the operation.
    </exception>
</member>

<member name="M:Inno.Tooling.Documentation.DocumentationEvidence.ReadAsync(System.String,System.String,System.Threading.CancellationToken)">
    <summary>
    Reads one bounded certificate whose digest was obtained independently from a trusted producer.
    It performs no network access, source scan, compilation or cache mutation.
    </summary>
    <param name="path">
    Explicit local certificate file; symbolic links are rejected.
    </param>
    <param name="trustedIdentity">
    SHA-256 obtained from an authenticated workflow artifact or locally reconciled producer.
    Computing this value from an arbitrary downloaded file does not establish trust.
    </param>
    <param name="cancellationToken">
    Cancels reading before an immutable certificate is returned.
    </param>
    <returns>
    A caller-owned immutable value, reusable across matching snapshot sessions.
    </returns>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.IOException">
    The file is missing, oversized, linked, corrupt or structurally invalid.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.OperationCanceledException">
    The read was canceled.
    </exception>
</member>

    <summary>
    Owns a protected immutable snapshot and answers transport-independent documentation requests.
    Concurrent queries are supported; the owner must finish them before disposing the session.
    Exact reads and symbol lookups do not initialize keyword-search postings.
    </summary>

<member name="M:Inno.Tooling.Documentation.DocumentationSnapshot.ExportCatalogAsync(System.Threading.CancellationToken)">
    <summary>
    Exports canonical metadata for coverage, navigation and rendered-anchor verification.
    Reads protected cached pages only; it does not rescan a checkout or refresh the snapshot.
    </summary>
    <param name="cancellationToken">
    Cancels reads without changing the selected generation or source content.
    </param>
    <returns>
    Complete page and project metadata. Missing project entries remain null; API evidence remains explicit.
    </returns>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.IOException">
    A cached page is missing, corrupt or outside its owned boundary.

<member name="M:Inno.Tooling.Documentation.DocumentationStore.IndexAsync(System.String,System.String,System.String,System.Threading.CancellationToken)">
    <summary>
    Explicitly scans a Docs checkout and publishes a consistent generation using reusable parsed pages.
    </summary>
    <param name="workspaceRoot">
    Absolute workspace owning the cache registration; may be the engine or Docs checkout.
    </param>
    <param name="documentationRoot">
    Explicit Docs checkout containing content/en and reference/engine.lock.json. No sibling path is inferred.
    </param>
    <param name="cacheRoot">
    Exclusive documentation cache boundary beneath workspaceRoot, outside the authored content tree.
    </param>
    <param name="cancellationToken">
    Cancels scanning, waiting and preparation before atomic selection. The previous generation remains readable.
    </param>
    <returns>
    The published snapshot identity and the number of parsed and reused pages; source API remains unverified.
    Query-only changes rebuild the index while reusing pages whose parser, source and payload identities match.
    </returns>
    <remarks>
    Independent page preparation uses at most four workers and retains each page's exclusive lease.
    Catalog validation and generation publication occur only after all workers finish. Worker parsing
    and registration timing totals can overlap; PagePreparation reports their enclosing wall time.
    </remarks>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.IOException">
    Inputs change during preparation, paths escape ownership, or a reference, contract or inclusion is invalid.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.InvalidDataException">
    Reference hashes, contexts, project ownership or required catalog relationships are inconsistent.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.OperationCanceledException">
    Preparation is canceled. Completed immutable payloads remain registered for safe maintenance.
    </exception>
</member>

    <summary>
    Opens one immutable generation without scanning authored content or acquiring an update lock.
    </summary>
    <param name="cacheRoot">
    Absolute prepared cache root. This method does not prepare or download missing content.
    </param>
    <param name="snapshot">
    Exact generation identity, or null to resolve the currently published pointer once.
    </param>
    <param name="expectedSourceTree">
    Expected engine input tree, or null when the caller only needs the explicitly bound documentation snapshot.
    </param>
    <param name="cancellationToken">
    Cancels reading lease acquisition and manifest loading.
    </param>
    <param name="sourceEvidence">
    Explicit certificate authenticated during preparation, or null for an unverified session.
    A certificate must cover the exact source tree and every protected API reference.
    </param>
    <returns>
    A caller-owned query session. Dispose it after the final query to release its generation reading lease.
    </returns>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.IOException">
    The snapshot is missing, corrupt, outside its boundary or produced by an incompatible parser schema.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.OperationCanceledException">
    Reading acquisition is canceled.
    </exception>
</member>
